messages:
Gabe Rivera: Alert — Firefly Systems (acct FF-778) missed INV-2026-091 for $9,600. Customer emailed saying unexpected AWS overage; asking to split payment and request a $900 usage credit. Tagging CS and Legal.
Hector - CS: They called. Finance lead is asking for 30/35/35 split and immediate lift of suspension. Seemed urgent; said they'll wire first installment this week if we accept. Ticket #TKT-5144.
Sofia Kim: Collections policy: we can do up to 60 days with initial >= 30%. Credits <= $1,000 are manager-approve. I'll approve $900 if CS provides logs and a short RCA. Require signed payment plan and initial 30% cleared before removing suspension.
Gabe Rivera: Proposed schedule after $900 credit: balance $8,700 -> 30% ($2,610) due 2025-12-05, 35% ($3,045) due 2026-01-05, 35% ($3,045) due 2026-02-05. No late fees this cycle.
Diane (Legal): Quick note: include clause "credit contingent on signed payment plan" and limit to one-time goodwill credit. Also require customer acknowledgement of TOS around usage throttling. No other redlines.
billing-bot: Dunning notice #2 sent at 1964000600. Auto-suspend timer paused for 72h per manual override.
Hector - CS: Customer agreed to 30/35/35 and will sign DocuSign. Asked if we can anonymize job IDs on invoice lines. That's fine.
Sofia Kim: Send DocuSign with the payment schedule and the $900 credit memo. If initial payment not received by 2025-12-07, resume suspension and escalate. Add account note: "Payment plan approved conditional on 30% initial payment and signed agreement."
billing-bot: DocuSign sent -> viewed at 1964001800. Reminder scheduled: verify-initial-payment on 2025-12-06.
Gabe Rivera: I'll monitor. If they push for more credit after eng confirms overage, route to VP Finance. For now proceed with approved $900 and staged payments.
Hector - CS: I'll confirm when DocuSign signed and collect wire ref.
Sofia Kim: Thanks team. If payment posts, update ledger and clear suspension hold. If it fails, escalate to Legal and Collections immediately.
